mapper.select: SELECT id, customer_id AS customerId, conversion_status_code AS conversionStatusCode, height, weight, selected_priority_category AS selectedPriorityCategory, history_json AS historyJson, activity_json AS activityJson, past_surgery_or_hospitalization AS pastSurgeryOrHospitalization, desired_budget_code AS desiredBudgetCode, received_at AS receivedAt FROM webform_response WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id AS customerId, name, birth_date AS birthDate, gender, sales_user_id AS salesUserId FROM potential_customer WHERE id = #{customerId}
SELECT category_name FROM insurance_category WHERE category_code = #{categoryCode} AND is_active = TRUE LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO insurance_plan ( webform_response_id, plan_name, total_premium, script_data, recommendation_type_code ) VALUES ( #{webformResponseId}, #{planName}, #{totalPremium}, #{scriptData}, #{recommendationTypeCode} )

INSERT INTO insurance_plan_coverage ( plan_id, coverage_id, selected_order, applied_premium ) VALUES
( #{planId}, #{coverage.coverageId}, #{coverage.selectedOrder}, #{coverage.unitPremium} )

INSERT INTO recommendation_log ( potential_customer_id, target_insured_type, webform_response_id, sales_user_id, recommended_category_code, total_score, recommend_reason, script_data, insurance_plan_id ) VALUES ( #{potentialCustomerId}, #{targetInsuredType}, #{webformResponseId}, #{salesUserId}, #{recommendedCategoryCode}, #{totalScore}, #{recommendReason}, #{scriptData}, #{insurancePlanId} )
mapper.select: SELECT ip.id AS planId, ip.plan_name AS planName, ip.total_premium AS totalPremium, rl.total_score AS totalScore, rl.recommend_reason AS recommendReason FROM insurance_plan ip JOIN webform_response wr ON ip.webform_response_id = wr.id LEFT JOIN recommendation_log rl ON rl.insurance_plan_id = ip.id WHERE wr.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY ip.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ic.id AS coverageId, ic.coverage_name AS coverageName, ic.category_code AS categoryCode, ipc.applied_premium AS premium, ipc.selected_order AS selectedOrder FROM insurance_plan_coverage ipc JOIN insurance_coverage ic ON ipc.coverage_id = ic.id WHERE ipc.plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY ipc.selected_order ASC
